about: For each skill with an eval suite under .claude/evals/<skill>/: the digest of the skill's instructions (SKILL.md, not references/; the skillMd for a node skill) and its suite at the last decision, and whether the eval ran (with scores) or was skipped (with the reason and who decided). pnpm check:skill-evals fails when the digest changes. The eval costs money, so the developer decides: run it, or record a skip. Reasoning: aimeat/scripts/check-skill-evals.ts.

aimeat-writing.note: opus, 3 runs per case per arm. Before (old SKILL.md, old suite): commit-message 1.00/1.00 (0.00), finnish-ui-copy 1.00/1.00 (0.00), operator-help-line 1.00/0.92 (+0.08), $2.03.
